Shows city walls, streets, villages, forests, temples, pagodas, rivers, and roads. Covers Yanjiao, Xianghe from the east, to Sanjiadian, Liangxiang in the west, from Huairou, Changping, Nankou in the north to Gu'an, Zhuozhou in the south. Relief shown by hachures. Pen-and-ink. "Meiji 27-nen seihan." Title from accompanying index sheet. Sheets individually numbered and titled, e.g.: Pekin kinbō dai 1-gō, Ryū-ke mura = Liu jia tun. Includes index map to adjoining sheets. Some sheets annotated in pencil or red ink. LC copy mounted on linen. Gaihōzu. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Japanese in Chinese characters. ARP
